violation_type.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))
violation_type.short_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired
violation_type.typical_finding: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.

finding_variants.text: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.
One wooden composite play structure leaning is not set up according to manufacturer's instructions.
Several broken board and openings were observed in the fence. The plastic seats of two swings were observed to be cracked.

The gate outside leading to the front of the house, has nails sticking out and does not latch fully due to the gate having wood that is bending.    The operation's neighbor's fence is starting to lean towards the operation's backyard. There's plants leaning over the fence.
There were broken toys observed on the outdoor playground.  The provider removed the items during inspection.
The step ladder attached to the outdoor play structure was not secured to the base. There were steps missing on the play structure to climb on the the horizontal ladder.
